documents.call-notes-ledgerly.md:
# Call with Ledgerly (renewal check-in), Oct 28

Attendees: Dana (VP Sales, Ledgerly), me

- Dana: "Honestly if you turned this off tomorrow I'd have to rebuild the forecast in spreadsheets again. My board asks for this view every month."
- They added 4 more seats in September after the RevOps lead started using it for weekly pipeline review.
- Asked for: Salesforce support (their parent company uses Salesforce), a Slack digest.
- Pricing: she said $500/month is "a rounding error" next to one missed quarter. Asked why we don't charge per seat.
- Referred us to the CRO at Tallyfin.
